decisions.reason: Plugin A (progress strip) is the only crash: unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction(...) throws TypeError at render; alpha.2 contract dropped it for useSessionStatus (useSessions stays) per both slots-contract excerpts; B uses no standard-kit hooks and throws nothing; one fault with shared blast radius.

Cites dock-render-tree and console follow-up: one DrawerErrorBoundary wraps the whole input.dock list, its null fallback unmounts all entries including B's chips; the attach button survives in conversation.input.left behind a different boundary.

Disable/re-enable control pins the teardown to A and proves B renders once freed; explicitly says it does not prove B is bug-free on alpha.2 nor that A's crash is the only dock defect; reinstalling B re-delivers unbroken code; colleague's removed-prop-for-both theory refuted by B's no-kit-hooks fact and failed prediction.

Feature-detects useSessionStatus vs useSessionPendingInteraction vs neither, never calls a missing seat, normalizes to a per-id lookup that degrades to not-pending; only the pending indicator is lost while running/todos/token/ETA and the bar keep working; silence justified because a throw re-trips the shared boundary and blanks every co-tenant.

Client HMR/re-link + hard refresh with no host restart, both dock entries asserted mounted, paste/chips end-to-end and session-switch re-mount regression for B; tenant hygiene (feature-detect, own error boundary) plus host per-entry boundary option with blast-radius vs coherent-dock trade-off.
